description: Verify the 6-digit code sent by request_verification_code. On success, returns a session_token, pass this exact string as session_token to list_my_rides, get_ride_status, cancel_ride, and redeem_gift. The token expires after 24 hours.

phone.description: Must match the phone passed to request_verification_code (any common format; non-digits other than a leading + are stripped server-side).

name: verify_code
title: Verify a phone code
